correctness.rationale: The source sphericity formula is transformed exactly into h=u^2/(u^2+w^2+4v^2). The complete projective endpoint analysis uses two affine charts on u=0 and one chart at [1:0:0]. The aspect -1 line has Hessian kernel equal to its tangent and a positive normal eigenvalue; the aspect 1 point has negative-definite Hessian diag(-8,-2). The source's submersion-away-from-endpoints result excludes all other critical points. Submersion pullback and local principal-bundle trivialization transfer the clean Hessian statement to Q and Q/G.
